cost: O(materialized TSV bytes + output bytes + verification file bytes) memory and Rust work, with additional card-cache lookup and database query cost. Verification invokes one export per selected file. Hash maps have expected linear processing, not worst-case proof.
forward: filters accepts twelve literal keys, splitting at first equals and preserving order/duplicates. export materializes files/sets/rows TSV via SQL, groups raw ten-column rows by aid, then Doc::text. Exactness is selected only for one file filter and one file record; otherwise leading blanks zero, final newline true and each block gets >=1 trailing blank. verify compares disk bytes and load-time SHA1, independent DB counters, optional card counters.
inverse: Unknown filter keys or missing equals cannot yield parsed filters. Empty set materialization cannot yield a successful empty export. A missing disk file with matching export SHA1 cannot itself create a failure note in bad.

For exact export text, compatible store states contain ordered raw rows/comments and blank/newline metadata producing that text; IDs, unused runs and other annotation sets remain unobserved. Nonexact output loses original leading/trailing blank information, so its preimage is wider.
file=a=b yields key file and value a=b; empty values and duplicate keys are syntactically admitted. SQL variable last-write semantics are not established by parser checks.
For one MWT span 1-2, words 1,2,3 and empty node 3.1, counters are [1,2,3,1,1]. The inside_to cursor resets per sentence; malformed IDs fall back to zero rather than structural validation.

bytes_ok requires equal bytes plus SHA1 when disk exists, or SHA1 alone when absent. counts_ok compares stored file/database count vectors independently; matching bytes cannot imply counter agreement.

Inside a recognized Size section, five cells are reduced to ASCII digits and parsed; punctuation/sign information is discarded. Repeated part names overwrite previous JSON entries; unrelated sections disable collection.
limitations: Finite helper/fixture evidence only; no DuckDB integration or SQL semantics
Partial syntax projection; no macro expansion or full semantic proof
No executable approximate profile or speedup claim
state: The Rust assembly preserves JSON comment order and returned row order; SQL must supply deterministic order. Empty matched sets is an error. ud_counts counts a multiword row as one surface token, suppresses covered word tokens, counts decimal IDs as empty nodes.
